description: This file defines the AWS SDK client class for the Amazon Kinesis Analytics V2 service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, describing, and updating applications, along with asynchronous variants.

classes.name: KinesisAnalyticsV2Client
classes.description: A client class to interact with the Amazon Kinesis Analytics V2 service, extending the AWS SDK core client.

methods.name: addApplicationCloudWatchLoggingOption
methods.description: Adds a CloudWatch logging option to an application.

methods.name: addApplicationInput
methods.description: Adds input to an existing application.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new Kinesis Analytics application.

methods.name: describeApplication
methods.description: Returns information about a specific application.
